item_merges.statement: Earlier-run comparison, not a construction on these manuscript pages. (1) In the Tate category generated by h(P¹)=1⊕L, tensor automorphisms fix the unit inclusion, whereas the prescribed Lefschetz raising operator sends the unit class to a nonzero point class. Thus this specific action is not induced by a motivic tensor subgroup; the rational graded Chow-correspondence action remains available. Ordinary End(h(P¹)) is Q⊕Q, and matrix units belong to total graded Corr* with Tate twists. This excludes only the prescribed action, not arbitrary abstract SL₂ subgroups in other groups. (2) For a smooth projective d-fold, the degree cocharacter w(s)|H^r=s^r and the shifted Lefschetz Cartan λ(s)|H^r=s^(r−d) satisfy w(s)=s^d·id·λ(s) on the chosen realization; on P¹, diag(1,s²)=s·id·diag(s^−1,s). The scalar shift is variety-dependent, not a uniform tensor identity. (3) Tensor naturality for L:h^i(X)→h^(i+2)(X)(1) gives gLg^−1=χ_Q(1)(g)^−1L after trivializing the Tate line, equivalently χ_L(g)L for L=Q(−1). Lowering scales by the reciprocal character; kerχ commutes with the normalized Lefschetz action in the stated graded setting.
item_merges.reason: A single compound comparison item preserves three separately stated clauses: prescribed P¹ tensor-action obstruction, shifted Cartan/degree relation, and Tate-character conjugation. No theorem identification between the clauses is asserted.

claim_merges.statement: For smooth projective connected X,Y over an algebraically closed field, a one-cycle Z on X×Y induces a unique homomorphism Pic0_red(X)→Alb(Y) characterized by D↦alb_Y(pr_Y*((D×Y)·Z)) whenever the intersection is defined. claim_merges.statement: A homomorphism u:A→B of abelian varieties induces an isomorphism on rational H1 (equivalently rational Tate modules) for one prime ℓ different from the characteristic if and only if u is an isogeny; then it does so for every such ℓ. Its inverse in Hom(B,A)⊗Q is represented by a rational correspondence and induces the inverse realization map.
